message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time access to market data, so I can’t give you the current Bitcoin price right now.  
If you need the latest price, you can check a reliable source such as:

* **CoinGecko** – https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/bitcoin  
* **CoinMarketCap** – https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/bitcoin/  
* **CryptoCompare** – https://www.cryptocompare.com/coins/coinslist  

These sites update their prices every few seconds/minutes. If you’d like, I can show you how to pull the price programmatically using an API (e.g., CoinGecko’s free API) or how to set up a simple script to fetch it. Just let me know!

We can attempt to use an external API, but we don't have internet access. We could provide a placeholder or explain that we cannot fetch real-time data. Alternatively, we could use a function to retrieve from a database, but we don't have a database with Bitcoin prices. So we should respond that we cannot fetch real-time data. Possibly we can suggest using an API like CoinGecko or CoinMarketCap. But the user asked directly. We can say we don't have real-time data. Provide a general approach.
